issues.issue: Does fear of a blood feud amount to a Convention ground (section 96)?
issues.applicant_position: Family fears death from a blood feud declared by rival families over alleged 1945-47 killings.

issues.issue: Would the claimants face a risk to life or torture in Albania (section 97), given credibility?
issues.applicant_position: Blood feud threatens the family; principal claimant was attacked and fears retribution in Albania.
issues.result_quote: the claimants will not be subjected to a risk to their lives
